[SWS_PER_00553]
⌈
When
ara::per::FileStorage::OpenFileRead-
Write
with
ara::per::OpenMode
or
ara::per::FileStorage::Open-
FileWriteOnly with ara::per::OpenMode (or one of the overloaded versions
ara::per::FileStorage::OpenFileReadWrite with ara::per::OpenMode
and separate buffer or ara::per::FileStorage::OpenFileWriteOnly with
ara::per::OpenMode and separate buffer) is called, Persistency shall first check
whether the provided mode contains either kAtTheBeginning, possibly combined
with kTruncate and kAppend, or kAtTheEnd, possibly combined with kAppend, or
only kTruncate. Otherwise, the call shall return directly with kInvalidOpenMode.
⌋
